title: Assessing Effects of Climate and Technology Uncertainties in Large Natural Resource Allocation Problems
abstract: The productivity of the world's natural resources is critically dependent on a variety of highly uncertain factors, which obscure individual investors and governments that seek to make long-term, sometimes irreversible investments in their exploration and utilization. These dynamic considerations are poorly represented in disaggregated resource models, as incorporating uncertainty into large-dimensional problems presents a challenging computational task. In this paper, we apply the SCEQ algorithm (Cai and Judd, 2021) to solve a large-scale dynamic stochastic global land resource use problem with stochastic crop yields due to adverse climate impacts and limits on further technological progress. For the same model parameters, the range of land conversion is considerably smaller for the dynamic stochastic model as compared to deterministic scenario analysis. The scenario analysis can thus significantly overstate the magnitude of expected land conversion under uncertain crop yields.
abstract_zh: 全球自然资源的生产率在很大程度上取决于多种高度不确定的因素，这使得寻求进行长期甚至不可逆投资的个体投资者和政府，在勘探与利用资源时难以作出判断。这些动态考量在细分的资源模型中往往未能得到充分体现，因为将不确定性纳入高维问题是一项具有挑战性的计算任务。本文应用SCEQ算法（Cai and Judd, 2021），求解一个大规模动态随机全球土地资源利用问题，其中作物产量因不利气候影响和技术进步受限而具有随机性。在相同的模型参数下，与确定性情景分析相比，动态随机模型下的土地转换范围明显更小。因此，在作物产量不确定的情况下，情景分析可能显著高估预期的土地转换规模。

Climate Change Impact on Economic Growth: Regional Climate Policy under Cooperation and Noncooperation
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We develop a novel analysis of climate change and policy regarding climate damages to growth under regional cooperation or noncooperation. We introduce a new stylized climate module and compute the regional social cost of carbon (SCC) when climate change impacts the growth rate of regional GDP under cooperation and noncooperation between regions. We find that in the presence of climate damage to economic growth, the regional SCC is high in either a cooperative or a noncooperative world, implying that it is optimal for each region to choose stringent climate policies. Moreover, relative to cooperation, noncooperation reduces the GDP of countries in both high northern latitudes and the tropics, while the loss for developing countries in the tropics is especially significant. The welfare losses to the tropics are larger still in the absence of compensatory transfers from wealthier regions most responsible for climate change.
abstract_zh: 本文对气候变化及其政策进行了新颖的分析，聚焦于在区域合作或不合作的情形下，气候损害对经济增长的影响。我们引入了一个新的简化气候模块，并在气候变化影响各地区GDP增长率的情形下，计算合作与不合作两种情形下的区域碳的社会成本（SCC）。我们发现，在存在气候损害影响经济增长的情况下，无论是在合作还是不合作的世界中，区域碳的社会成本都很高，这意味着各地区选择严格的气候政策是最优的。此外，与合作相比，不合作会降低北部高纬度国家和热带国家的GDP，其中热带发展中国家的损失尤为显著。若缺乏最应为气候变化负责的富裕地区提供的补偿性转移支付，热带地区的福利损失将更大。

title: Dynamics of Global Emission Permit Prices and Regional Social Cost of Carbon under Noncooperation
Costs of Forest Carbon Sequestration in the Presence of Climate Impacts
abstract: Forests play a critical role in mitigating climate change, and, at the same time, are predicted to experience large-scale impacts of climate change that will affect the efficiency of forests in mitigation efforts. Projections of future carbon sequestration potential typically do not account for the changing economic costs of timber and agricultural production and land use change. We integrated a dynamic forward-looking economic optimization model of global land use with results from a dynamic global vegetation model and meta-analysis of climate impacts on crop yields to project future carbon sequestration in forests. We find that the direct impacts of climate change on forests, represented by changes in dieback and forest growth, and indirect effects due to lost crop productivity, together result in a net gain of 17 Gt C in aboveground forest carbon storage from 2000 to 2100. Increases in climate-driven forest growth rates will result in an 81%–99% reduction in costs of reaching a range of global forest carbon stock targets in 2100, while the increases in dieback rates are projected to raise the costs by 57%–132%. When combined, these two direct impacts are expected to reduce the global costs of climate change mitigation in forests by more than 70%. Inclusion of the third, indirect impact of climate change on forests through reduction in crop yields, and the resulting expansion of cropland, raises the costs by 11%–38% and widens the uncertainty range. While we cannot rule out the possibility of climate change increasing mitigation costs, the central outcomes of the simultaneous impacts of climate change on forests and agriculture are 64%–86% reductions in the mitigation costs. Overall, the results suggest that concerns about climate driven dieback in forests should not inhibit the ambitions of policy makers in expanding forest-based climate solutions.
abstract_zh: 森林在减缓气候变化中发挥着关键作用，但与此同时，预计森林也将遭受气候变化带来的大规模影响，这将削弱其在减缓行动中的效率。目前对未来碳汇潜力的预测，通常未考虑木材和农业生产经济成本的变化以及土地利用变化。我们将一个动态前瞻性的全球土地利用经济优化模型，与全球植被动态模型的结果以及气候变化对作物产量影响的元分析相结合，以预测未来森林的碳汇。我们发现，气候变化对森林的直接影响（表现为枯死和森林生长率的变化），以及作物生产力下降带来的间接影响，共同导致2000至2100年间地上森林碳储量净增加17 Gt C。气候驱动的森林生长率上升，将使2100年实现一系列全球森林碳储量目标的成本降低81%–99%，而枯死率上升则预计使成本提高57%–132%。两项直接影响合并来看，预计可使全球森林领域的气候变化减缓成本降低70%以上。纳入气候变化通过作物减产及由此引发的耕地扩张所产生的第三种间接影响后，成本将提高11%–38%，并扩大不确定性范围。虽然我们无法排除气候变化提高减缓成本的可能性，但气候变化对森林与农业同时产生影响的核心结果是，减缓成本降低64%–86%。总体而言，研究结果表明，对气候驱动的森林枯死的担忧，不应阻碍决策者扩大以森林为基础的气候解决方案的雄心。

title: Impacts of Forest Loss on Local Climate across the Conterminous United States
The Role of Uncertainty in Controlling Climate Change
venue: Oxford Research Encyclopedia of Economics and Finance
abstract: Integrated assessment models (IAMs) of the climate and economy aim to analyze the impact and efficacy of policies that aim to control climate change, such as carbon taxes and subsidies. A major characteristic of IAMs is that their geophysical sector determines the mean surface temperature increase over the preindustrial level, which in turn determines the damage function. Most of the existing IAMs assume that all of the future information is known. However, there are significant uncertainties in the climate and economic system, including parameter uncertainty, model uncertainty, climate tipping risks, and economic risks. For example, climate sensitivity, a well-known parameter that measures how much the equilibrium temperature will change if the atmospheric carbon concentration doubles, can range from below 1 to more than 10 in the literature. Climate damages are also uncertain. Some researchers assume that climate damages are proportional to instantaneous output, while others assume that climate damages have a more persistent impact on economic growth. The spatial distribution of climate damages is also uncertain. Climate tipping risks represent (nearly) irreversible climate events that may lead to significant changes in the climate system, such as the Greenland ice sheet collapse, while the conditions, probability of tipping, duration, and associated damage are also uncertain. Technological progress in carbon capture and storage, adaptation, renewable energy, and energy efficiency are uncertain as well. Future international cooperation and implementation of international agreements in controlling climate change may vary over time, possibly due to economic risks, natural disasters, or social conflict. In the face of these uncertainties, policy makers have to provide a decision that considers important factors such as risk aversion, inequality aversion, and sustainability of the economy and ecosystem. Solving this problem may require richer and more realistic models than standard IAMs and advanced computational methods. The recent literature has shown that these uncertainties can be incorporated into IAMs and may change optimal climate policies significantly.
abstract_zh: 气候与经济综合评估模型（IAMs）旨在分析旨在控制气候变化的政策（如碳税和补贴）的影响与效果。IAMs的一个主要特征是，其地球物理部门决定了相对于工业化前水平的平均地表温度升幅，而这又决定了损害函数。现有的大多数IAMs假设所有未来信息均已知。然而，气候与经济系统中存在显著的不确定性，包括参数不确定性、模型不确定性、气候临界风险和经济风险。例如，气候敏感度是一个广为人知的参数，衡量大气碳浓度翻倍时平衡温度的变化幅度，而文献中其取值范围可从低于1到超过10。气候损害同样存在不确定性：一些研究者假设气候损害与瞬时产出成比例，另一些研究者则假设气候损害对经济增长具有更持久的影响。气候损害的空间分布也存在不确定性。气候临界风险代表（近乎）不可逆的气候事件，可能导致气候系统发生重大变化，例如格陵兰冰盖崩塌；临界事件的发生条件、概率、持续时间及相关损害同样存在不确定性。碳捕集与封存、适应、可再生能源和能效方面的技术进步同样具有不确定性。未来的国际合作以及国际协议在控制气候变化方面的执行可能随时间变化，这可能源于经济风险、自然灾害或社会冲突。面对这些不确定性，决策者必须作出兼顾风险厌恶、不平等厌恶以及经济和生态系统可持续性等重要因素的决策。解决这一问题可能需要比标准IAMs更丰富、更贴近现实的模型以及先进的计算方法。近期文献表明，这些不确定性可以纳入IAMs，并可能显著改变最优气候政策。

title: To Build or Not to Build? Capital Stocks and Climate Policy
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: We investigate how irreversibility in “dirty” and “clean” capital stocks affects optimal climate policy, from both theoretical and numerical perspectives. An increasing carbon tax will reduce investments in assets that pollute, and so reduce emissions in the short term: our “irreversibility effect”. As such the “Green Paradox” has a converse if we focus on demand side capital stock effects. We also show that the optimal subsidy increases with the deployment rate: our “acceleration effect”. Considering second-best settings, we show that, although carbon taxes achieve stringent targets more efficiently, in fact renewable subsidies deliver higher welfare when policy is more mild.
abstract_zh: 本文从理论和数值两个角度，考察“高碳”与“低碳”资本存量中的不可逆性如何影响最优气候政策。碳税的提高将减少对污染性资产的投资，从而在短期内减少排放，这是我们所称的“不可逆效应”。因此，若聚焦于需求侧的资本存量效应，“绿色悖论”的结论可能相反。我们还表明，最优补贴随部署速度的提高而增加，这是我们所称的“加速效应”。在次优情形下，我们发现：尽管碳税能更高效地实现严格的减排目标，但当政策较为温和时，可再生能源补贴实际上能带来更高的福利。

title: Numerical Solution of Dynamic Portfolio Optimization with Transaction Costs
Computational Methods in Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: Computational methods are required to solve problems without closed-form solutions in environmental and resource economics. Efficiency, stability, and accuracy are key elements for computational methods. This review discusses state-of-the-art computational methods and their application in environmental and resource economics.
abstract_zh: 在环境与资源经济学中，许多问题没有闭式解，需要借助计算方法求解。效率、稳定性和精度是计算方法的关键要素。本综述探讨了最新的计算方法及其在环境与资源经济学中的应用。

title: The Social Cost of Carbon with Economic and Climate Risks
abstract: Uncertainty about future economic and climate conditions substantially affects the choice of policies for managing interactions between the climate and the economy. We develop a framework of dynamic stochastic integration of climate and economy, and show that the social cost of carbon is substantially affected by both economic and climate risks and is a stochastic process with significant variation. We examine a wide but plausible range of values for critical parameters with robust results and show that large-scale computing makes it possible to analyze policies in models substantially more complex and realistic than usually used in the literature.
abstract_zh: 未来经济和气候状况的不确定性，实质性地影响着管理气候与经济相互作用的政策选择。我们构建了一个气候与经济的动态随机整合框架，并表明碳的社会成本受到经济风险和气候风险的显著影响，且是一个具有显著波动的随机过程。我们考察了关键参数在广泛而合理范围内的取值，得到了稳健的结果，并表明大规模计算使得分析比文献中通常使用的模型更为复杂、也更贴近现实的政策成为可能。

Model Uncertainty and Energy Technology Policy: The Example of Induced Technical Change
abstract:
Over the past four decades, numerical modeling based on economic principles has become the dominant analytical tool in U.S. energy policy. Energy models are now used extensively by public agencies, private entities, and academic researchers, and in recent years have also formed the core of "integrated assessment" models used to analyze the relationships among the energy system, the economy, and the global climate. However, the widespread application of these models in policy analysis poses challenges to decision-makers. In addition to the "black-box" problem – that the workings of complex models may be simply unintelligible to non-specialists – fundamental uncertainties are intrinsic in what has become the typical circumstance of multiple, "co-existing" models embodying different representations of the energy-economy, and producing different policy-relevant outputs that model users are compelled to interpret as equally plausible and/or valid. Because the policy implications of these outputs can diverge substantially, policy-makers are confronted with a significant degree of model-based uncertainty and little or no guidance as to how it should be addressed. Decision-makers may reasonably infer that such "ensemble uncertainty" accurately reflects the present-day limits of our ability to predict the consequences of large-scale energy or environmental policy. If so, then the problem of rationally taking account of this form of uncertainty should be analyzed in its own right.
This problem of "model uncertainty" has recently been the focus of groundbreaking work in macroeconomics, where scholars have studied the problem of how a decision-maker should proceed in the face of uncertainty regarding the correct model of an economic system that is the object of policy. A unifying theme in this work is the identification of decision-rules that are robust to such uncertainty. This paper describes a first attempt to apply to energy modeling the macroeconomists’ insights and methods related to model uncertainty and robust analysis, focusing on the important example of model representations of technical change. Using a well-known model by Goulder and Mathai, we treat contrasting assumptions on technical change – and their implications for CO2 emissions abatement policy – as a phenomenon of model uncertainty. We apply non-Bayesian decision rules – min-max and min-max regret – to this problem and computationally solve the model under the min-max regret criterion, yielding a policy – an emissions abatement path – that reflects a form of robustness to the model uncertainty.
abstract_zh:
过去四十年间，基于经济学原理的数值建模已成为美国能源政策中占主导地位的分析工具。能源模型如今被公共机构、私营实体和学术研究人员广泛使用，近年来也构成了用于分析能源系统、经济与全球气候之间关系的“综合评估”模型的核心。然而，这些模型在政策分析中的广泛应用给决策者带来了挑战。除了“黑箱”问题——即复杂模型的运行机制对非专业人士而言可能完全不可理解——一个更根本的不确定性在于，典型情况下存在多个“并存”的模型，它们对能源—经济关系的刻画各不相同，产生的政策相关结果也各异，而模型使用者被迫将这些结果视为同样合理和/或有效。由于这些结果的政策含义可能存在巨大分歧，决策者面临着相当程度的基于模型的不确定性，却几乎没有关于如何处理这一问题的指导。决策者可以合理地推断，这种“集合不确定性”准确反映了我们当前预测大规模能源或环境政策后果能力的局限。如果确实如此，那么理性地考虑这种形式的不确定性，本身就应当作为一个独立的问题加以分析。
这一“模型不确定性”问题最近成为宏观经济学开创性研究的焦点，该领域的学者研究了当决策者面对所关注经济系统的正确模型存在不确定性时应如何行事。这类研究的一个统一主题，是识别对此类不确定性具有稳健性的决策规则。本文首次尝试将宏观经济学家关于模型不确定性和稳健分析的见解与方法应用于能源建模，重点考察技术变革的模型刻画这一重要例子。我们以Goulder和Mathai的一个知名模型为基础，将关于技术变革的相互对立的假设及其对CO2减排政策的影响，视为一种模型不确定性现象。我们应用非贝叶斯决策规则——极小极大（min-max）和极小极大遗憾（min-max regret）——来处理这一问题，并在极小极大遗憾准则下对模型进行了数值求解，由此得到一条减排路径，该路径体现了对模型不确定性的某种稳健性。
